title: European Registry for Robin sequence
summary: Registry for the prospective evaluation of children with Robin sequence in various European health care centres specialised in the treatment of Robin sequence. Robin seqeunce is a rare disease, aproximately one in 10,000 children is born with this condition. In the context of our project ‘European Registry for Robin sequence’, we would like to gather information on the course of the disease, its treatment, and the developmental outcomes of children with Robin sequence.
conditions: Congenital malformation syndromes predominantly affecting facial appearance

interventions.name:
Registry for the prospective evaluation of children with Robin sequence in various European health care centres specialised in the treatment of Robin sequence. The registry is an observational study.
Robin seqeunce is a rare disease, aproximately one in 10,000 children is born with this condition.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Diagnosis of Robin sequence (isolated or syndrome-associated), a combination of glossoptosis, micrognathia and upper airway obstruction → all three criteria must be met
- Age at inclusion maximum 12 month
- Any gestational age and any sex
- Parent or guardian, who provided consent
Exclusion criteria:
Participants whose parents/guardians are unable to understand the study protocol or are unable to give informed consent, for example due to a language barrier.
